Skin: Skin academic knowledge includes allergic contact dermatitis, drug-induced reactions, infection-related cutaneous manifestations, erythrodermic psoriasis treatment, chronic urticaria diagnosis, and blistering disorders. Broader coverage extends to fungal infections, autoimmune conditions, neurologic cutaneous associations, and differential diagnosis of inflammatory and infectious dermatoses.
Psychiatry: Psychiatry encompasses neurocognitive disorders (delusions, subcortical dementia etiologies), pharmacological management (antipsychotic administration, escitalopram adverse effects, akathisia), therapeutic interventions (electroconvulsive therapy complications), eating and neurodevelopmental disorders (anorexia nervosa treatment, Tourette syndrome), SPIKES communication protocol, and ethical frameworks (advance directives, paradoxical suicide risk).
